why: Restore the ordinary diner crowd at Chubby Buffalo's BBQ without touching the I Fought the Law scene. The diner shell, open-world crowd spawner and every patron/staff workspot are ordinary Glen streaming data, and the kept Glen open-world community phase activates the crowd at boot. This proposal adds no quest prefab and no scene actor: it re-issues the diner's 28 relaxed crowd entries after a proximity wait so the diner is populated on a fresh start, using the interior TV as the device anchor.

open_questions: Confirm on the dev tour that the diner crowd is present after arrival. The kept hey_gle_phase already activates #hey_gle_sq012_diner_crowd_com whole at boot; this venue phase re-issues 28 individual entries after proximity per playbook rule 6. Check that re-activation does not duplicate any patron already spawned by the boot pass.

The five omitted alert entries are the arcade/nervous-phone variants. The checker rejects a whole-community activation because the catalogue's aggregate posture for #hey_gle_sq012_diner_crowd_com is alert, even though 28 of its 33 entries are relaxed. If the owner wants the full 33, the checker needs a way to express a whole-community activation with a per-entry relaxation override; otherwise the diner runs with 28.

The proximity anchor is a TVControllerPS, not a door. The diner's entrance is not a quest-driven device at all (it is ordinary world streaming), so the runtime door policy cannot act on it and none is needed. Confirm the entrance opens normally and the main TV streams before the player is deep inside.

Confirm the kept open-world Glen community phase (hey_gle_phase, reached from the kept open_world_global_commuinity_phase) actually runs in the clean-slate save. If it does not, the diner needs the boot activation as well, and the whole Glen crowd layer is missing.

If the owner prefers not to duplicate the boot activation, the alternative is to leave this venue to the global phase and accept that a fresh start may miss the diner until the sector reloads. The proposal deliberately re-issues because rule 6 records that failure.

proximity_wait.why: The diner's only resolved device entities are the four q003 TVControllerPS sets in the interior; this is the main TV in the room the crowd uses. It streams with the diner interior and a player who walks in is inside the wait radius, so the post-wait re-issue fires when the venue is actually loaded. A workspot would never fire (playbook rule 8). The TV's q003 interaction actions are left alone; it is only the anchor.
